description: Reply to a comment on one of your posts, given postId and accountId from soclo_inbox_comments. UNLIKE a direct-message reply, a comment reply IS PUBLIC: visible to anyone who can see the original post. Pass confirm: true only after the owner approved the exact text; without it, this returns a preview and sends nothing at all. Needs the separate manage:inbox permission.

accountId.description: The connected account id, from soclo_accounts_list or a prior inbox call.

confirm.description: true only after the owner approved the exact text or change. Omit or pass false to get a preview instead: nothing is sent, nothing is saved.

message.description: The exact text to send, approved by the owner.

postId.description: The post the comment is on, from soclo_inbox_comments.

name: soclo_inbox_reply_comment
title: Reply to a comment publicly
